newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Iraqi Kurds in Iran dying of cold, need relocation.
newsitem.headline: Iraqi Kurds in Iran dying of cold, need relocation.

text.p: The U.N. refugee agency urged Iran on Friday to relocate 65,000 Iraqi Kurdish refugees stranded in icy mountains in an inaccessible border area with no access to international relief where children were dying of cold.
Spokeswoman Christiane Bertiaume said her agency's chief Sadako Ogata and Iran's Interior Minister Ali Mohammad Besharati would discuss the crisis in talks in Geneva later this month.
"The situation is grave. It could develop into a new humanitarian disaster," Berthiaume told a Geneva briefing.
"UNHCR has had no access to the area for two weeks. Temperatures are sub-zero. The refugees have to be relocated immediately. If they remain in this condition many will die."
The refugees fled fighting between Kurdish factions in north Iraq in late August. UNHCR has appealed to Iran to move them inland but no action has so far been taken, Berthiaume said.
